$comment: Slug rename ledger. Append-only — record every rename that has been published widely enough that downstream consumers may have adopted it. Skip the ledger for force-renames that happen before any downstream picks the slug up (typos caught quickly). Two independent monotonic cursors: `renames[*].seq` for place_slug renames, `items[*].seq` for lift/slope/webcam id renames; consumers track only the seq spaces they care about. See ../docs/SLUG-LIFECYCLE.md for the full flow.
